Amazon's early kickoff autumn Prime Day mega sale is in full swing, with thousands of deals already up for grabs. While more Apple products will join the discount lineup next week, we've already seen the AirTag 2 hit a historic low, this M5 Pro MacBook Pro slashed by $500, various MacBook Air models discounted by up to $150, and some of Apple's newest releases also offering discounts.

In addition to the above deals, there are also smart TV discounts of up to $1,200, a large selection of MagSafe chargers and external batteries, Amazon smart speakers and displays discounted by up to 50%, plus smart home upgrade products and more. Please continue reading below for details, and stay tuned, as we will be updating this article continuously until next week.
